post_preparation_statistics.method: Explicit ANALYZE after promotional issuance and publication refresh

phase_population_limit: Completed bodies only for phase quantiles; all emitted requests remain in observable latency verdict; client stages are not exact server admission or socket queue time
boundary_limits: Same-host time.monotonic: handler entry after native accept/setblocking/cloexec, pre_request entry after HTTP parser, handler exit after native response cleanup. No exact TCP accept timestamp, socket-only queue, app/DB CPU or causal observer overhead. Only synthetic IDs; file append after handler exit.
occupation_limits: Only observed synthetic ID handle intervals intersected with actual window-close clock; no CPU or observer append/bookkeeping outside handlers. Missing/unidentified connections not inferred.
